title: Whole Fused-fissure Living Stone
description: One newly authored complete above-ground living-stone succulent body: two broad fleshy leaf crowns remain fused through one continuous tapering lower body, while a real narrow curved finite-depth fissure divides their upper faces. The low broad crowns carry integral irregular muted window-like face patches; these opaque matte colour regions are not simulated translucent tissue. This is one connected closed mesh, not two detached cotyledons, an exposed radicle, jointed cactus paddles, a pair of rocks or a pot arrangement. One static stylised plant-body prop, zero scenes. Roots and flowers are not depicted. No exact species, biological scale, growth, propagation, cultivation, medicinal, ecological or physiological claim.
